children: Phillips 66 (PSX) filed a Form 8K - Director, Officer or Compensation Filing - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on October 05, 2026.
On September 29, 2026, Richard G. Harbison, Executive Vice President, Refining of Phillips 66 (the "Company") provided notice to the Company that he intends to retire, effective December 31, 2026.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1534701/000119312526413219/d76010d8k.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1534701/000119312526413219/0001193125-26-413219-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
